entities.name: Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen is an ongoing armed conflict between the Yemeni government, the United States and their allies, and al-Qaeda-affiliated groups in Yemen. It is a part of the Global War on Terrorism. Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen was a conflict in Asia (1998). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
